title: Talk of drones and a burning flame on Trump's D.C. arch worries aviation experts
summary: Aviation safety experts were wary of Trump's proposed arch near D.C.'s airport. Then came the FAA's unusual lighting recommendations — including an eternal flame on top — and Trump's talk of drones.
author: Rachel Treisman
